zh.title: 幾何色塊・珍珠耳環女孩
zh.description: 把經典肖像變成牆上的幾何色塊。四片洞洞板拼成一幅畫，色彩之外，也保留收納的可能。
zh.imageAlt: 四片實際列印的洞洞板拼成珍珠耳環女孩，呈現藍色頭巾與黃色幾何色塊

en.title: Girl with a Pearl
en.description: A classic portrait, reimagined in bold geometric color. Four pegboard panels come together as one artwork, with room to hang the things you love.
en.imageAlt: Four printed pegboard panels form a geometric girl with a blue headscarf and yellow accents
